senses.gloss: उपेप्सा॑ f. desire to obtain, MaitrS. ii, 9, 8; ŚBr.
उपेप्सा॑ f. See p. 214, col. 1.
उपेत mfn. one who has come near or approached, one who has betaken himself to, approached (for protection), arrived at, abiding in MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.
one who has obtained or entered into any state or condition, one who has undertaken (e.g. a vow), MBh.; Ratnāv.; Sāh. &c.
come to, fallen to the share of Prab.
(a pupil) who has approached (a teacher), initiated, Yājñ. iii, 2; ĀśvGṛ. i, 22, 21; 22; PārGṛ. iii, 10, 10
accompanied by, endowed with, furnished with, having, possessing, MBh.; R.; Bhag.; Hit. &c.
one who has approached (a woman sexually), T.
उपेत-पूर्व mfn. one who has gone to a teacher before, ĀśvGṛ.
उपेतव्य mfn. to be set about or commenced Comm. on TāṇḍyaBr. iv, 10, 3.
उ॑पेति f. approach, approximation, RV.
उपेतृ mfn. one who sets about or undertakes, Mn. vii, 215.
1. उपेत्य mfn. to be set about or commenced, TāṇḍyaBr. iv, 10, 3; 4.
2. उपेत्य ind.p. having approached, approaching &c.
उपेय mfn. to be set about or undertaken, a thing undertaken, Mn. vii, 215; Mālav.
to be approached sexually, Mn. xi, 172
to be striven after or aimed at, that which is aimed at, aim, Naiṣ. Comm. on VarBṛS.
उपेयिवस् mfn. one who has approached &c.
उपेक्ष m. N. of a son of Śva-phalka, Hariv.
उपेक्षा f. overlooking, disregard, negligence, indifference, contempt, abandonment, MBh.; Ragh.; Hit. &c.
endurance, patience
dissent
trick, deceit (as one of the minor expedients in war), L.
regard, L.
उपेक्षक mfn. overlooking, disregarding, indifferent, BhP.; Mn.; Sāṃkhyak.
उपेक्षण n. the act of disregarding, overlooking, disregard, indifference, connivance, MBh.; Hit.; Sarvad. &c.
not doing, omission, Lāṭy. i, 1, 26
care, circumspection, Car.
उपेक्षणीय mfn. to be overlooked or disregarded, unworthy of regard, any object of indifference, R.; Ragh. Comm. on Nyāyad. &c.
उपेक्षित mfn. looked at
overlooked, disregarded &c.
उपेक्षितव्य mfn. to be looked at
to be regarded or paid attention to, Nir.; R.
to be overlooked or disregarded, Śārṅg.
1. उपेक्ष्य mfn. id., Suśr.; R.; Pañcat. &c.
2. उपेक्ष्य ind.p. having looked at, looking at
overlooking &c.
उपेडकीय or उपैडकीय Nom. (fr. एडक) P. उपेडकीयति or उपैड्˚, to behave as a sheep towards, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 94.
उपेन् (उप-√ इन्).
उ॑पेनित mfn. driven in, pressed or pushed in ŚBr.
उपेन्द्र m. ‘younger brother of Indra’, N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (born subsequently to Indra, especially as son of Aditi, either as Āditya or in the dwarf Avatāra), MBh.; Hariv.; R.; VP. &c.
N. of a Nāga, L.
उपेन्द्रा f. N. of a river, MBh.; VP.
उपेन्द्र—गुप्त m. N. of various men.
उपेन्द्र—दत्त m. N. of various men.
उपेन्द्र—बल m. N. of various men.
उपेन्द्र—वज्रा f. N. of a metre (consisting of four lines of eleven instants each).
उपेन्द्र—शक्ति m. N. of a merchant.
उपेन्ध्य mfn. (√ इन्ध्), to be kindled or inflamed, Pat.
√ 1. उपेष् (उप- 1. इष्) P. to tend towards, endeavour to attain, MaitrS. i, 2, 14.
2. उपेष् (उप-√ ईष्) P. (inf. उपेषे॑, RV. i, 129, 8) to rush upon.
3. उपेष् (उप-आ-√ ईष्) Ā. (1. sg. ईषे) to approach (with prayers), apply to, implore, RV. i, 186, 4; v, 41, 7.
4. उपेष् (उप-√ एष्; for the Sandhi See Pāṇ. vi, 1, 94) P. उपेषति, to creep near, approach creeping, AV. vi, 67, 3.
उपे॑षत् अन्, m. N. of an evil demon [NBD.], AV. viii, 6, 17.
